label: prop:photon-threading-mass
title: Mass as photon threading cost
html:
Proposition. Mass as photon threading cost

Let \mathfrak{H} be a knot composite with braid word \beta_{\mathfrak{H}} \in B_n. The categorical mass \mathfrak{m}_{\mathfrak{H}} (mass identity) equals the total Gröbner--Shirshov reduction cost of threading the photon strand \gamma through the hadron braid:

  \mathfrak{m}_{\mathfrak{H}}
  =  (q - 1)^2 \sum_{\text{Hecke steps}}
  |c_w| \cdot |q - q^{-1}|.

The sum runs over all Hecke reductions \sigma_i^2 \to (q - q^{-1})\sigma_i + 1 required to move the photon strand from above \beta_{\mathfrak{H}} to below \beta_{\mathfrak{H}} in the augmented braid \gamma \otimes \beta_{\mathfrak{H}} \in B_{n+1}. The values c_w denote the coefficients at each step.
